visual.alt_text: Three-step Subjective and Objective Language organiser. Read: Language highlighter. Notice: Identify evaluation and emotion. Correct the student's mix-up using the full task.

answers.text: Keep “Copy the title, then choose an answer without analysing the language or text.”; it uses a detail that sounds familiar.
Choose “Change the purpose and audience halfway through, then report the first impression only.” instead; it sounds clearer.
Choose the plan that analyses language evidence and produces a reviewable response. Mark factual, evaluative and emotional words in short reports, reviews and advertisements.
